selection.pool: first-parent commits C in (range.after, range.through] that are the merge commit of a merged pull request into development; the issue is the first closing issue reference of the pull request, else the number in the head branch <type>/<issue>-<desc>
keep: the pull request names an issue and the number is an issue
the head branch is not archive/...
no pull request merged earlier in the pool names the same issue
the issue body was last edited at or before the close
selection.revision: C^1, the first parent of the merge commit that closed the issue
selection.type: the head-branch prefix before the first /
selection.area: the two leading path segments (one for a root file) with the most changed files in C^1..C, excluding .agro/tasks/, .agro/evals/, and CHANGELOG.md; a tie takes the lexically first area
selection.order: sha256 of the decimal issue number, ascending

split.rule: stratified by area; the held-out capacity of an area is its number of cases outside never_heldout, at most its case count less 1 when it has 2 or more cases; each area with 2 or more cases and a positive capacity first gets 1 held-out slot; each next slot goes to the area with capacity left and the largest value of heldout * cases / total - slots, a tie takes the lexically first area; within an area, the held-out cases are the first cases in order that are not in never_heldout

selection.body: gh issue view <issue> --json body, saved as corpus/issues/<issue>.md
